title: Brown University shooting
place_text: Barus and Holley building, Brown University, Providence, Rhode Island

tellings.quote: Valente executed his plan on Saturday, December 13th, 2025.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that a man named Claudio Neves Valente carried out a planned shooting on Saturday, December 13, 2025, at the Barus and Holley building of Brown University in Providence, Rhode Island. Michels draws on a US Department of Justice transcript of videos Valente made. He tells it in an episode asking why leading American scientists are going missing, as one piece of that larger pattern.
